focus.en: Nouns take fixed prepositions: an increase in, a decrease in, a reason for, a problem with, demand for, experience in, a copy of, a payment of, a reply from, a complaint about.
focus.uk: Іменники теж вимагають сталих прийменників: an increase in, a decrease in, a reason for, a problem with, demand for, experience in, a copy of, a payment of, a reply from, a complaint about.

exercises.text: There's been a sharp increase ___ office expenses.

why.en: An increase in something; an increase of + an amount (an increase of 5%).
why.uk: An increase in — чогось; an increase of + величина (an increase of 5%).

exercises.text: We've noticed a decrease ___ sales this quarter.
exercises.uk: Цього кварталу ми помітили зниження продажів.

why.en: A decrease in something, like an increase in.
why.uk: A decrease in — чогось, як і an increase in.

exercises.text: There's a problem ___ the printer again.
The demand ___ accountants is high in Alberta.
exercises.uk: В Альберті високий попит на бухгалтерів.

exercises.text: Do you have any experience ___ payroll?
exercises.uk: Чи маєте ви досвід нарахування зарплати?

why.en: Experience in or with a field.
why.uk: Experience in або with — досвід у певній галузі.

exercises.text: Please send me a copy ___ the invoice.
exercises.uk: Будь ласка, надішліть мені копію рахунку-фактури.

exercises.text: I'd like to make a payment ___ $500 on my account.
exercises.uk: Я хочу внести платіж на 500 $ на свій рахунок.

exercises.text: We still haven't had a reply ___ the supplier.
exercises.uk: Ми досі не отримали відповіді від постачальника.

why.en: A reply from someone; a reply to a message.
why.uk: A reply from — від когось; a reply to — на повідомлення.

exercises.text: The client complained ___ the late delivery.

why.en: Complain about something; complain to someone.
why.uk: Complain about — на щось; complain to — комусь.
